title: SpinBox focus_exited is not emitted when it should
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9595) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9400F CPU @ 2.90GHz (6 threads) - 15.87 GiB memory

### Issue description

I have a SpinBox that I can edit and I would like to detect when user quits its edition.

My issue is that `SpinBox::focus_exited` signal is emitted in a way that makes it impractical to use it for my needs. Let's say I have a SpinBox and a Button, and that my spinbox is focused (in edition) : 
* If `focus_mode` is set to `None`, the SpinBox never emits `focus_exited` signal, but its internal LineEdit emits `focus_exited` signal when I click on Button
* If `focus_mode` is set to `Click`, the SpinBox and the internal LineEdit emit `focus_exited` signal when I click on a SpinBox arrow, but only LineEdit emits `focus_exited` signal when I click on the Button
* If `focus_mode` is set to `All`, the SpinBox and the internal LineEdit emit `focus_exited` signal when I click on a SpinBox arrow or when I click on the Button
* It seems `Accessibility` mode works the same way than `None` mode

**What I would expect :** 
* No matter the focus mode, SpinBox should not emit `focus_exited` when I click on its arrows
* SpinBox should emit `focus_exited` when it looses focus from a user standpoint

### Steps to reproduce

See the MRP bellow on which you can test the focus_exited behaviors with different focus modes.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp-spinbox-focus-exited.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32232312/mrp-spinbox-focus-exited.zip)
